# Mythory Copilot instructions

Follow the repository-wide contract in `AGENTS.md`.

Additional Copilot behavior:

- Use the custom agents in `.github/agents` for the matching role.
- Copilot Free has a small monthly request limit: prefer short, task-scoped sessions and
  leave long implementation work to OpenCode or Kilo Code.
- Run `npm run format` after editing and `npm run check` before finishing.
